canonical_example.translation: The vending machine swallowed my coin but won't give me my drink!

canonical_example.text: Juan tiene que tragarse las quejas constantes de su suegro, que vive con ellos.
canonical_example.translation: Juan has to put up with constant complaints from his father-in-law, who lives with them.

canonical_example.text: Tuve que acompañar a mi hija al concierto de ese grupo de chicos, y me lo tragué enterito.
canonical_example.translation: I had to take my daughter to that boy band concert and sit through the whole thing.

canonical_example.text: Siempre acabo tragándome los problemas de los demás cuando ya tengo bastante con los míos.
canonical_example.translation: I always end up listening to other people's problems when I've already got enough of my own.

canonical_example.text: Casi me trago un buzón de correos por ir mirando el celular.
canonical_example.translation: I almost wrapped myself around a mailbox because I was looking at my cellphone.

canonical_example.text: Iba conduciendo borracho y se tragó una farola.
canonical_example.translation: He plowed into a lamppost while driving when drunk.

canonical_example.text: Nuestros gatos no se tragan: cada vez que los juntamos, se bufan el uno al otro.
canonical_example.translation: Our cats can't stand each other: every time we put them together, they hiss at each other.

canonical_example.text: El viento esparció mis apuntes por la calle y corrí para atraparlos.
canonical_example.translation: The wind scattered my notes along the street and I ran to catch them.

canonical_example.text: Las autoridades informaron que ayer atraparon al líder del cártel de drogas.
canonical_example.translation: The authorities reported that the drug cartel leader had been captured yesterday.

canonical_example.text: Las algas atraparon al buzo, pero logró zafarse.
canonical_example.translation: The seaweed trapped the diver, but he managed to break loose.
